title: Five Large Physics Models, one per design space
description: Five design spaces, one model each: an extruded-fin heat sink (1-D fin theory), a Joukowski airfoil (exact potential flow), a converging-diverging nozzle (quasi-1-D isentropic flow), a shell-and-tube exchanger (Kern + Gnielinski + epsilon-NTU) and an L-bracket (immersed finite-element elasticity). Each is drawn, built, written as a dataset with its manifest, fitted with batched design-space training on a split by geometry, and reported in a card with what the run measured and what it did not. PYTHONPATH=. python examples/lpm_five_models/run.py --geometries 24
domain: neural surrogates for engineering design spaces
